invariants: exact current canonical pytest-collected item population only
every canonical item identity assigned exactly once
configured historical heavyweight source paths isolated to distinct seed shards
remaining items assigned in canonical pytest collection order by deterministic round robin
item execution order within each shard preserves canonical collection order
same-head collection and manifest generation must be deterministic
no skip, marker, benchmark freshness, assertion or test-content mutation
no required-check substitution, ruleset mutation or runner cutover
SIQ READY and OVC merge readiness semantics remain unchanged

qualification_plan.phase_1: exact collection census and initial four-way shadow
qualification_plan.phase_2: inspect per-shard durations and rebalance only through versioned deterministic policy evidence if needed
qualification_plan.phase_3: repeat same-head or same-tree comparable shadow runs and compare against canonical required tests
qualification_plan.stop_boundary: consolidated operator decision before any required-check substitution/removal or visible context retirement

rollback: Remove or supersede only the post-PYT shadow policy/workflow/tooling/state. Preserve current required tests and all historical evidence.
